endorsements.quote: Implement federated learning and advanced AI techniques to protect patient data and enhance privacy while developing clear and consistent consent processes tailored to different legal frameworks, ensuring patients are well-informed about data usage.

unlisted_practices: Establish standardized data formats and protocols and adopt a common data model (e.g., OMOP) to ensure consistent data quality and interoperability for AI.

Make AI-based solutions accessible to all countries and population groups by investing in healthcare infrastructure, training healthcare professionals, and creating supportive policies, especially in low- and middle-income countries.
Use natural language processing to convert unstructured clinical text into structured data that AI systems can use.
Harmonize the clinical information models of wearable and IoT devices before incorporating their data into AI systems.

screen.reason: Summit report and multi-stakeholder recommendations discussing the impact of digital health and AI on primary immunodeficiencies care.
